messages.content: Design a circuit breaker with a retry budget to prevent cascading upstream outages.
Half-open probes reset consecutive failure counters after a successful recovery.
The retryBudgetExceeded counter tracks exhausted attempts without retrying non-idempotent writes.
Reject OAuth callbacks when the state nonce does not match the browser session.
Rotate refresh tokens after exchange and revoke the token family on refresh token reuse.
PKCE code_verifier validation failed: invalid_grant in the authorization code exchange.
Use a concurrent index build to avoid blocking writes during the customer table migration.
The migration failed with SQLSTATE 23505 duplicate key value violates unique constraint customers_email_key.
Backfill nullable tenant_id in batches before adding a validated NOT NULL constraint.
Prevent a Redis cache stampede using a singleflight request coalescing lock.
Use randomized TTL jitter to spread cache expirations across the minute.
A stale-while-revalidate window serves the last cached value while one worker refreshes it.
Fix the TypeScript generic constraint in the usePagination hook.
The emitted declaration file lost the readonly tuple inference.
